enchantments.tooltip: +4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Flaming Burst: This weapon is sheathed in fire, and deals 1 to 6 fire damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 fire damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
Reflex Save +4: This item gives a +4 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.

Path of the Fire Dragon: While wearing this item and in sun stance, you gain a +54 Equipment bonus to Fire Spell Power , which increases damage from spells and fire finishing moves such as Breath of the Fire Dragon.
